target: AArch64 native ZealC in UTM-bundled QEMU with HVF, one vCPU, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard and tablet
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-tos-distro-prep-current-latest-qemu.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-tos-distro-prep
checks: Executed stock TOSDistro DistroPrep operations on a source-backed namespace
Copied the full /Home source tree into /Demo/AcctExample
Converted the bundled source tree into text format
Verified TOSDistro.ZC and HomeSys.ZC were produced in the output tree
Recovered the graphical terminal; zstatus failed=0
scope_note: This accepts DistroPrep only. It does not accept MakeStdDistro or produce a bootable ARM64 RedSea/UEFI ISO; BootDVDIns remains an explicit ArmBoot stub for legacy BIOS installation.
